translation: And the itching of the scrotum was especially severe; the sinews in the scrotum were knotted like earthworms, and only by rubbing and kneading did they disperse; the skin peeled off very thickly, and I did not count the times. I also rubbed left and right, front and back, and the tinea of the four limbs shed its skin and healed. Because the six yang channels go up to the head and meet at the crown, reasoning from this, the six yin channels must go up the penis and meet at the tip.
